question: Which of the following Mughal rulers is believed to have ruled under the influence of his father-in-law, Itmad-ud-Daulah?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jahangir.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **fourth Mughal Emperor** was **Jahangir.**
 
• From **1605 until his death in 1627,** he was in power.
 
• **Salim Chishti, an Indian Sufi saint**, is the inspiration for his **name.**
 
• Jahangir wed **Noor Jahan,** the widowed daughter of his **wazir Ghiyas Beg.**
 
• He also gave his **father-in-law** the title of **Itmad-ud-daula, or "Pillar of the Empire."**
 
• Soon after getting married, Nur Jahan established **her own group,** which she called **Nur Jahan's Junta**.
 
• Along with herself, it included her mother **Asmat Begum, father Itimad-ud-daula, and prince Khurram.**
 
• Each person in this group was **intelligent and had important positions **in the government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bahadur Shah-II:**

 
 
• He was the** twentieth and last Mughal Emperor.**
 
• He was also an** Urdu poet.**
 
 
 
• **Humayun:**
 
 
• He was the** second Mughal emperor**, in charge from** 1530 to 1540 **and again from **1555 to 1556.**
 
• His domain included what are now** Eastern Afghanistan, Pakistan, Northern India, and Bangladesh.**
 
 
 
• **Shah Alam-I:**
 
 
• **Bahadur Shah I** was also known as **Shah Alam I.**
 
• He was the 7th** Mughal Emperor **who ruled from **1707 until his death in 1712.**
